correctness.rationale: The proof handles every r≥1 and every nonempty finite prime-set word. The local exact identity T(n)=n A_S/D_S proves necessity of product balance and the valuation shifts. Product balance excludes primes outside the prescribed union; absence constraints force unique exponents off the intersection, while always-present primes supply independent free exponents. The constructed valuations have precisely the prescribed supports, making the formal steps actual T-iterates and giving periodic closure. Positivity of block multipliers proves equality of exact word and orbit periods. Weighted-simplex lattice counting gives the stated power of log with O((log X)^(d−1)) error. All boundaries (X<n*, K empty, singleton word, repetitions) are explicitly handled. A separate exact arithmetic verifier enumerated every rooted two-step periodic word n≤25000 and reproduced all fiber counts; finite checks are supportive, not infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Detailed full-text inspections of Guo (2026) and Dimitrov (2025), direct OEIS special-case checks, multiple targeted literature searches, published-result semantic comparisons, and comparisons with related published mathematical statements identified no statement implying the full all-length finite-word decision procedure, free-prime-support fiber, exact period relation, and rank-dependent count. Existing fixed-point and 1330 example cases are acknowledged as previously known. Originality is a supported self-review, not independent validation or proof that no unindexed equivalent exists.
residual_risks: A prior paper could formulate this elementary but general valuation-lattice consequence in terminology absent from the searches; searchable snippets alone do not exclude it.

Earlier pseudo-aliquot sequence papers cited by Guo, especially Brown and Vanden Eynden (1996), were not inspected in full; their focus is unbounded sequences, but possible implicit statements cannot be categorically excluded.
OEIS and Dimitrov cover some numerical or fixed-point subcases, so no originality is claimed for those instances or for the basic Dedekind-psi Euler product itself.

value.rationale: The question is directly motivated by recent work on positive periodic points and the classical psi-amicable pairs. The theorem completely decides every natural finite rooted prime-support pattern, does not merely list special numerical cycles, isolates a genuine local obstruction not detected by the product-one requirement (the formally balanced {2,7}/{2,3,5} example), identifies the only free prime-power directions and the exact dynamical period, and determines their complete fixed-fiber polylogarithmic abundance with an explicit constant. It creates a reproducible building block for analyzing periodic orbits without claiming a global classification or an aggregate count; no general or paper-sized theorem is required for the complete natural conditional classification to have value.
